pages.title: Projective Geometry
pages.text: $(thing)Projective Geometry$()$(br2)What a painter sees: parallel lines meet at the horizon, and lengths change, but straight lines stay straight.

$(thing)Insight$(): 80$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Coordinates, Curved Geometry.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 1 π Crystal.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): A camera has its screen a length f behind a pinhole and sees a thing of height H at a range Z. Write how tall its image I is.
